heading: [UZ] A Safe Space for Afghan Families
paragraph1: [UZ] Afghan Support was founded by members of the Afghan community in Phoenix who understand the challenges of starting over. We provide free, culturally sensitive assistance with immigration paperwork, housing applications, healthcare navigation, and connecting families to the resources they need to thrive.
paragraph2: [UZ] Our team speaks Dari, Pashto, and English. Every service is confidential and provided at no cost.
